verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes is a code-execution/infrastructure primitive (VM-isolated containers, file I/O, command exec) for building agents or apps, not a product with its own dataset or built-in AI insight/suggestion features over user data. The evidence pack shows only execution/session/file/tunnel APIs — no AI-generated insights or analysis output is a first-party product feature, making this axis a category mismatch rather than a gap.
